test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct direct narration of the given sentence.**

Ramu requested her to wait there till he returned.

options.text: Ramu says to her, “Please wait here till he return”.
Ramu said to her, “Please wait here till I return”.
Ramu say to her, “Please wait here till he returns”.
Ramu say to her, “Please wait here till I return”.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Ramu said to her, “Please wait here till I return”. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **indirect **speech, the statement made by the speakers is reported indirectly without using their exact words.
